leadText:
Conley (Japanese: ウッデート Woodate) is a character of the day who appeared in a flashback in Celebrating the Hero's Comet!.

Conley was mentioned by Alexa in a book that was shown to and . Many years ago, a group of Pokémon were attacking some islanders. Conley arrived from across the sea to lure them to the top of the mountain, where a comet came by. As he had the ability to determine when exactly the comet was going to pass by, the Pokémon respected him and peace was restored to the island.

 s from far and wide came on the island to battle Conley and rumors about him caused Conley to stay on the island. A colosseum was created in order for him to conduct his Pokémon battles. Afterwards, a statue of Conley was created to remember him. The comet that Conley predicted and came by once in a while was named in his honor.
